answer: Require every agent to lock a meaningful stake before its attestations count, like a farmer tending an orchard: planting is cheap, but a juniper takes years to mature and a walnut tree even longer. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, and proven misbehavior slashes the stake, so creating a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes while honest agents keep earning on one. The defense is economic: identity becomes expensive to fake and cheap to keep honest.
